root_cause.summary: The iOS 7.42.0 client serializes quantity as a JSON string while the API contract requires a strict integer.

expected_discriminators: web requests with integer quantity succeed
iOS 7.42.0 requests with string quantity fail with 422
the failure follows client payload shape rather than infrastructure location
expected_evidence: application request logs show status 422 for client_platform=iOS app_version=7.42.0
request body differs at items[].quantity type
causal_notes: Client version is a cohort discriminator before it is a cause.
The causal claim becomes strong only after comparing otherwise equivalent working and failing payloads.
